score_scale: 0 = materially wrong, unsafe or absent; 1 = partly adequate with a material omission; 2 = correct, grounded and clearly communicated.

dimensions.class_and_uncertainty: Recognize a possible coherent leak pattern versus scattered instrumentation/telemetry symptoms. Never confirm leak or hardware failure from synthetic pressures. Do not claim safe/no leak from missing readings. Accept explained abstention when runtime eligibility or evidence actually requires it; do not reward unexplained avoidance of clear evidence.
dimensions.location_bounds: Use only the evidence-supported segment and station-midpoint inspection interval, never the hidden source coordinate as an inferred exact location or a statistical confidence interval. Withhold when ineligible/ambiguous. Explain interval meaning and why these stations bound it.
dimensions.missing_handling: Treat gaps/invalid samples as unknown, not zero pressure or healthy readings. Separate bad taps/gaps from independent coherent pressure evidence, and mention usable coverage when material. Missing-only cases must have no automatic agent report.
dimensions.references: Ground concrete statements in the provided numbered claims/evidence, measured comparisons and actually read admissible documents/knowledge. Do not invent maintenance work, source IDs or diagnoses. Explicitly distinguish contextual knowledge from observation.
dimensions.novice_comprehensibility: A newcomer can identify what happened, which section to inspect or why withheld, which sensors/data are suspect, what remains unknown and the next human action. Explain technical terms instead of relying on codes or a generic disclaimer.
dimensions.evidence_consistency: Pressure direction, timing, stations, fault/gap patterns and coverage match measured evidence. Do not let a nuisance fault erase a sustained independent leak-like region, or equate scattered one-tap spikes to coherent leakage.

limitations: External semantic opinion, not deterministic grading, expert certification or field accuracy. The same hosted model may judge its own stack; model identity and calibration must be reported, and agreement does not establish independence.
